info.title: Kaspi Pay POS Automation API
info.description: REST API for integrating POS systems with Kaspi Pay API (SMS Authorization, Invoicing, QR Payments, Operation History, and Refunds).

ApiKeyAuth.name: X-API-Key
ApiKeyAuth.description: Theater API Key used for authentication and permission gating

TokenSN.name: X-Token-SN
TokenSN.description: Session token SN obtained after OTP verification

ProfileId.name: X-Profile-Id
ProfileId.description: Organization profile ID (optional, sent after auth)

get.description: Check if the server is up and running.

post.description: Starts the 3-step OTP SMS authentication process. Returns a unique process ID for the next steps.
Sends the phone number corresponding to the Kaspi Pay cashier account to initiate SMS-OTP code sending.
Submits the SMS code to complete authorization and generates session credentials.

otp.description: SMS confirmation code received by cashier

processId.description: Process ID of the current auth attempt

500.description: OTP verification failed or Kaspi API error

post.description: Allows frontend clients to verify the existence of a tokenSN.
Logs out and destroys the current auth state.

get.description: Retrieves the name and Kaspi account verification details of a client by their phone number.

post.description: Sends a payment request invoice directly to a customer's phone number.

403.description: API Key suspended, expired, or lacks invoice permission

example.error: Remote invoicing is not enabled for this API Key.
Failed to connect to Kaspi API

get.description: Retrieves the status of an existing invoice request using its operation ID.

post.description: Cancels a remote invoice that hasn't been completed yet.
Loads the history of recent invoices (up to 20).
Generates a Kaspi Pay QR code redirect link for customer scanning.

get.description: Retrieves the status of a QR transaction by its QR operation ID.

post.description: Retrieves the history of operations/statements for the specified period.

lastTransactionDate.description: Date of last transaction for pagination

post.description: Retrieves precise transaction details (payment types, items, commissions).
Initiates a refund/reversal process for a previously successful transaction.

qrOperationId.description: Operation ID of transaction to refund

get.description: Performs an active check against Kaspi Pay API to verify if session headers are still valid and authorized.

post.description: Generates a new API Key for a theater with configured path permissions.

expires_at.description: Optional expiration timestamp for the key (ISO-8601)

get.description: Lists all generated API Keys, their status, permissions, and connection states.

patch.description: Updates permissions, name, or suspension status of a specific API key profile.

expires_at.description: Optional expiration timestamp for the key (ISO-8601). Set to null to remove expiration.

delete.description: Permanently deletes and revokes an API key profile.

message.example: API Key for 'Grand Cinema' has been deleted.

post.description: Generates a remote invoice on Kaspi linked to a unique customer order and upserts the event context inside the local database.

orderId.description: Unique order identifier from the ticketing system

customerPhone.description: Customer mobile phone number in format 7XXXXXXXXXX

patch.description: Allows administrators to manually set the payment status of an order (e.g. Processed, Cancelled, Refunded) and automatically halts any active background polling for this transaction.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique database auto-incrementing ID or the custom POS order number

status.description: The new payment status. Note: 'CancelledByUser' is client-side QR payment cancellation, 'RemotePaymentCanceled' is client-side remote invoice rejection, and 'Cancelled' is manual administrator cancellation.

status_desc.description: Optional description or reason explaining the manual override
status_desc.example: Manually marked as paid by administrator

message.example: Order status manually updated to Processed.

404.description: Order not found or belongs to another organization

get.description: Retrieves aggregated sum of amounts and counts of orders grouped by payment status for a specific event.

200.description: Aggregated statistics for event returned successfully

get.description: Retrieves aggregated sum of amounts and counts of orders grouped by payment status across all events in the organization.

200.description: Aggregated statistics for overall organization returned successfully

get.description: Provides a paginated, filterable, and searchable list of all checkout order records mapped to their event details.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by specific order payment status. Note: 'CancelledByUser' indicates QR payment cancellation by client, 'RemotePaymentCanceled' indicates remote invoice rejection by client, and 'Cancelled' indicates manual administrator cancellation.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search term query (customer name, email, phone, or order ID)

post.description: Finds all non-final payment transactions in the database, queries their latest status from Kaspi Pay, and updates the local records.

200.description: Batch manual status update executed successfully
